name: tamirs-superpowers
description: 30 bundled skills, 10 specialist agents, smart worktree hooks, statusline, and MCP server stubs — plan, implement, review, debug, multi-agent setup, and audit code from one plugin.

github_token.title: GitHub token for the bundled github MCP server
github_token.description: Optional. A GitHub personal access token with repo scope. Leave blank to keep the github MCP server off - it refuses to start without one and nothing else needs it.

pushover_token.title: Pushover application token
pushover_token.description: Optional. From your Pushover application at pushover.net/apps. Leave blank to keep phone notifications off - the notification hook stays silent when unconfigured.

pushover_user.title: Pushover user key
pushover_user.description: Optional. Your Pushover user key from pushover.net. Required only if you set an application token above. Read by the Notification hook only; the mod sends nothing.

rate_limit_warn_percent.title: Rate-limit warning threshold (%)
rate_limit_warn_percent.description: The mod shows a band above the prompt with a handoff reminder once any rate-limit window (5h, 7d, spend) reaches this percentage. Claude Code and Claude Desktop only.

semantic_skill_suggest.title: Semantic skill suggestions (one small-model call per long prompt)
semantic_skill_suggest.description: Off by default. When on, prompts of 12+ words are classified by a small model against the bundled skill names and a matching skill is named to Claude as context. hooks/skill-suggest.sh's keyword matching stays on either way.

notification_hooks.title: Notification hooks (desktop and phone notifications, VPN exit check, usage-capture collector start)
notification_hooks.description: On by default. When off, the desktop notification, the Pushover phone notification, the VPN exit-node check and the usage-capture collector start stay silent, whatever else is configured. Safety, worktree and convenience hooks are unaffected. Read by the bash hooks only; hosts without plugin options use the default.

contributor_hooks.title: Contributor hooks (plugin-author reminders and checks)
contributor_hooks.description: Off by default. When on, the /reload-plugins reminder after a plugin-file edit, report.md link validation and the hand-written SKILL.md guard run. For people working on this plugin or on agent configuration; noise for everyone else. Read by the bash hooks only; hosts without plugin options use the default.

unresolved_write_notices.title: Unresolved-write notices from the protected-file guard
unresolved_write_notices.description: Off by default. When on, the protected-file guard tells Claude when a command writes somewhere it cannot resolve (an inline script, a path built at run time), so it was not checked against the protected-path rules. Writes the guard can resolve to a protected file are denied either way.

worktree_root.title: Session worktree root
worktree_root.description: Where the worktree hooks create session worktrees, as <root>/<repo>/<slug>. Default ~/.session-worktrees, outside ~/.claude: Claude Code treats any .claude directory as a protected path and prompts on every write there outside bypassPermissions mode, which no allow rule can pre-approve. A leading ~ or $HOME is expanded; a relative path is ignored. Existing worktrees under ~/.claude/worktrees keep working; scripts/worktrees-migrate.sh moves idle ones. The SUPERPOWERS_WORKTREE_ROOT environment variable overrides this, and is how hosts without plugin options set it. Read by the bash hooks only.
